2014_spells.ray-of-sickness.description: A sickly greenish ray of sickening energy lashes out toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is also poisoned until the end of your next turn.
2014_spells.ray-of-sickness.effectSummar: Deal 2d8 poison damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.ray-of-sickness.fullDescript: Using 1 action, on a failed save, it is also poisoned until the end of your next turn. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw; roll a d20, add the CON modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; Make a ranged spell attack against the target; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st. On a failed save, it is also poisoned until the end of your next turn.
